description.en:
Asks the match to end now, instead of waiting for the clock. It only sets the engine's end-of-match request flag; on its next update the match loop sees the flag and switches to its end state.
The story scripts call it at the end of their last scripted beat, after setting their story flags. It does not run the script's ScBtlResult by itself: btl0002.nut calls ScBtlResult() just before it.
